{{recipe}}

This idea is revolutionary. I mean, who would ever think about making a burger that was crispy and breaded, right?

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|ground beef chuck]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
* Panko [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
* 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
* [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|Mayonnaise]]

== Procedure ==
#Form chuck into 4-[[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] patties, about ¾ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick, with a slight depression in the middle. Season on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Dip burgers into beaten egg. Dredge in panko breadcrumbs and set aside.
#Heat a griddle over medium high heat for 2–3 minutes. Add enough olive oil to generously coat the pan, and add patties. Cook 3 minutes per side for medium rare, 4 minutes for medium, and 5 minutes per side for well done.
#Spread cut side of buns with mayo. Add a patty on top of the bottom half of a bun, then top with top half. Serve warm.

steps.text: Form chuck into 4-ounce patties, about ¾ inch thick, with a slight depression in the middle. Season on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Dip burgers into beaten egg. Dredge in panko breadcrumbs and set aside.

Heat a griddle over medium high heat for 2–3 minutes. Add enough olive oil to generously coat the pan, and add patties. Cook 3 minutes per side for medium rare, 4 minutes for medium, and 5 minutes per side for well done.
Spread cut side of buns with mayo. Add a patty on top of the bottom half of a bun, then top with top half. Serve warm.
